why: Gives Standard pricing and most benefits but omits priority scheduling, the 12-month monthly minimum and the Plus price and plumbing benefits ($269, flush, plumbing inspection) even though the fee schedule passage had the $269; all stated figures match the passages and the named fee schedule and plan document contain them.

Says the membership stays with the address, transfers to the next homeowner there and does not move, exactly as the Transfer passage states.
States the 2-year install labor warranty, the warranty diagnostic and the no-fee-if-covered rule; hours, fees, registration and brand terms all match the knowledge base.
States registration within 30 days and that it is required for the full parts term, and the cited Warranty Policy contains those facts.
Repairs over $1,000, all replacements, financing partner and 5-minute approval all match the FAQ payment passage.

Gives $189/$16.99, waived $89 diagnostic, 15% off parts and labor, two tune-ups and says same-day eligibility is not covered; every price, hour and capacitor range appears in the knowledge base, though the reply is cut off mid-sentence.
Says duct cleaning is not done in-house, is handled by a third-party partner and a referral is available, matching the service catalog.
Says Manor (78653) was added in April 2026 and the support hours quoted match the FAQ passage.
Hands off instead of giving the $149 to $290 drain clearing price in the reference; the troubleshooting advice, hours and $149 after-hours fee it does state are in the passages.
Says no veterans discount is documented and hands off, and the member discounts it lists (15% HVAC, 15% plumbing for Plus, waived diagnostic) are in the fee schedule passages.
Repairs over $1,000, all replacements, financing partner and about 5 minutes for approval all match the FAQ.

Gives the free Comfort Advisor estimate, the $8,000 to $16,000 range and the four pricing factors; the $500 member credit, financing, permit and disposal fees and warranty terms all match the knowledge base.
Gives $149 to $290 depending on access for a plumbing drain, and the $120 to $190 condensate figure and pooling-water advice are in the passages.
Says the price is not available and hands off, so none of the reference prices or benefits are stated; the upgrade, billing and price-lock details it gives match the passages.

Says no checks or cash to technicians and payment by card or ACH via a secure link, matching the FAQ payment section.
Corrects $79 to $89, notes the credit toward a same-visit repair and the member waiver, all in the FAQ and fee schedule.

States the $500 full system replacement credit for both Standard and Plus from the fee schedule passage and does not contradict the reference; the free estimate was not in the passages and the answer does not misstate it.

States all Standard and Plus prices, the 12-month minimum, $99 per extra system, and every listed benefit, matching the Comfort Club overview and fee schedule.
